subject: Examples of R Codes for survival analysis using INLA and INLA-MCMC approach (Gomez Rubio and Rue 2018) for handling missing covariate data

messages.author: b5df203d4c72831c
messages.subject: Examples of R Codes for survival analysis using INLA and INLA-MCMC approach (Gomez Rubio and Rue 2018) for handling missing covariate data
parts:
Hi all,

I am a relatively a new INLA user. I am interested to  know whether there is an example (or examples) of INLA codes written in plain R (not the ones implemented using R-INLA package) for survival analysis? I would like to use this example for enhancing my INLA understanding especially in survival analysis context.

Besides, is there any example that I can find for INLA-MCMC approach for handling missing covariate data in survival analysis (Gomez Rubio and Rue 2018)? I found it to be a very interesting alternative to MCMC after perusing through Gomez-Rubio and Rue 2018 paper. All the best and cheers.

Peter.

messages.author: 334c7505e0b5cf65
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Examples of R Codes for survival analysis using INLA and INLA-MCMC approach (Gomez Rubio and Rue 2018) for handling missing covariate data
parts: I am a relatively a new INLA user. I am interested to  know whether there is an example (or examples) of INLA codes written in plain R (not the ones implemented using R-INLA package) for survival analysis? I would like to use this example for enhancing my INLA understanding especially in survival analysis context.

If you are new to INLA check the books available for INLA:

http://www.r-inla.org/books

Also, you can check this one on-line: https://becarioprecario.bitbucket.io/inla-gitbook/ See the list of links in the preamble where more on-line materials are available.

Besides, is there any example that I can find for INLA-MCMC approach for handling missing covariate data in survival analysis (Gomez Rubio and Rue 2018)? I found it to be a very interesting alternative to MCMC after perusing through Gomez-Rubio and Rue 2018 paper.

All this code is here:

https://github.com/becarioprecario/INLAMCMC_examples

However, bear in mind that this is VERY SLOW. There is a chapter on missing values in the on-line book above that may help you. We are working on other algorithms that are faster than the Metropolis-Hastings to provide a faster alternative to this approach.

Best,

Virgilio
